sloka: अविच्छिन्न अश्रु वेगः तु सौमित्रिम् प्रेक्ष्य पार्श्वतः ।परिदेवयितुम् दीनम् रामः सम् उपचक्रमे ॥४-६-१९॥
transliteration: avicchinna aśru vegaḥ tu saumitrim prekṣya pārśvataḥ ।paridevayitum dīnam rāmaḥ sam upacakrame ॥4-6-19॥

translations.english: Rama began to wail piteously while tears streamed down his eyes incessantly. He looked at Saumitri standing by his side and said:
